deccan_fort_memory.label: Deccan hill fort memory
deccan_fort_memory.anchor: A remembered Deccan hill fort on black basalt, thick bastion, cannon ports and lime-washed walls. The view belongs to the landscape, with no identifiable observer.
deccan_fort_memory.absent: No coast, coconut palms, ships or present-day Travancore figures.
deccan_fort_memory.time: dry ochre memory under a hard sun

estate_quarters.label: Estate quarters and path in Travancore
estate_quarters.anchor: The doorway and path outside Nagoji's estate quarters in Travancore: red laterite walls, dripping tiled roof and coconut palms. The departing men walk along the same path.
estate_quarters.absent: No foreign fort, stone cell or European buildings.

ayyappa_temple.label: Hill temple of Ayyappa
ayyappa_temple.anchor: A small Ayyappa temple on a Travancore hill: low laterite gateway base, two-tiered sloping tiled roof on timber posts, worn stone steps, stone-pillared mandapa and lamp-niched courtyard wall. Everyone inside the precinct is barefoot.
ayyappa_temple.absent: No tall stone gateway tower, chairs or benches. No boots or carried talwar inside the precinct; boots and a talwar appear only at the foot of the outer steps. The fisherman and labourer stay outside the outer gateway.
ayyappa_temple.time: morning daylight with open clay and brass oil lamps

market.label: Travancore market and waterside track
market.anchor: The Travancore market under cloth and palm-leaf awnings: rice, pepper sacks and oil jars; the woman stallholder's cloth table, piled with cloth and backed by pepper sacks, with the young scribe's low desk at its end. The stallholder remains behind her table with her baby. Seated traders sit cross-legged on low platforms or mats. The last awnings open onto a firm track toward a distant red laterite Travancore fort with tiled gatehouse.
market.absent: No European-style chairs, foreign bastions or blue-coated soldiers. The stallholder is not Revathi and the scribe is not Ramayyan.

drill_ground.label: Travancore fort drill ground
drill_ground.anchor: The flat training strip inland from the red laterite Travancore coastal fort, with sloping tiled gatehouse roofs. In firing-line views the line is seen side-on, and anyone watching stands behind the firing line or at its flank, never in front of the muzzles.
drill_ground.absent: No foreign fort, blue-coated drill master, red uniform, named recruit or extra observers.

backwater_quay.label: Travancore backwater quay
backwater_quay.anchor: A narrow working quay among Travancore channels and lagoons, coconut palms, cargo barrels and low sack-laden boats. Ibrahim and his visitors remain on the quay. The small whitewashed Dutch bastion belongs only on the far bank when the view opens toward it.
backwater_quay.absent: No quay turned into a foreign harbour, no ocean-going ship alongside the barrels, no European furniture.

ridge_path.label: Bund and climbing path below the Travancore fort
ridge_path.anchor: The walk from the backwater quay along a paddy bund and up the coastal ridge beneath the red laterite Travancore fort. The fort remains above and behind the walkers; the hill temple, market, drill ground and backwaters lie below, with the sea beyond the inlet.
ridge_path.absent: No fort transplanted into the lower panorama, no foreign bastions, no chairs.

coastal_hall.label: Travancore coastal hall threshold
coastal_hall.anchor: The entrance of the Travancore coastal hall from chapter 6, at the top of a short flight of stone steps: timber pillars carved with vines and tigers under a sloping tiled roof, the long side open toward the sea. Inside, men sit on woven floor mats over palm leaves and cups of buttermilk. Ramayyan and Nagoji remain standing at the doorway through their exchange.
coastal_hall.absent: No European chairs, benches, stools or throne; no foreign fort or glass lamps.
coastal_hall.time: dusk with newly lit clay and brass oil lamps

consolidation_montage.label: Travancore campaign routes across seasons
consolidation_montage.anchor: A temporal montage of Travancore campaign routes: a flooded river crossing, a dusty northern pass and a monsoon track deep in mud, in three flowing vertical bands. Nagoji appears once in each separate time-band, not as three riders in one moment.
consolidation_montage.absent: No foreign setting, battle casualties or clean inset borders between the seasons.
consolidation_montage.time: rain, hard dry-season sun and monsoon gloom in their respective bands

levy_gate.label: Travancore chieftain's grain-levy gate
levy_gate.anchor: The gate and threshold of a Travancore chieftain's compound, laterite walls, timber doorway and tiled eaves. An empty bullock cart waits in the road; mounted Maravar lancers fill the road behind Nagoji while Padmini stands at the threshold.
levy_gate.absent: No European furniture, foreign fort or Ponnan-like red shoulder cloth on the unnamed lancers. This heavy lord is not the lean Attingal chief.

return_road.label: Wet road from the Attingal estate
return_road.anchor: The wet Travancore road leading away from the subdued Attingal estate, the returning mounted column behind Varma and Nagoji, ash still on their clothes.
return_road.absent: No chief's sons in the returning column; no foreign buildings or victory furniture.

barracks.label: Travancore barracks meal room
barracks.anchor: A Travancore barracks beneath tiled eaves with laterite walls and timber supports. Nair soldiers, Maravar riders and Nagoji eat barefoot in a row on woven floor mats, rice on plantain leaves, boots lined up by the door.
barracks.absent: No chairs, benches, stools, dining tables or boots on diners' feet.
barracks.time: evening, clay and brass oil lamps

estate_tree.label: Jackfruit tree in the estate yard
estate_tree.anchor: The roots of a great jackfruit tree in the Travancore estate yard. Nagoji sits directly among the roots with his knees bent. Across the yard the kalari glows; the hill temple is distant.
estate_tree.absent: No chair, bench, stool, foreground companion, inset, prison cell, chain or iron on the wrist.

night_overlook.label: Night panorama from the estate rise
night_overlook.anchor: An unpeopled view from the Travancore estate rise: scattered lamps at temple, red laterite fort, market, backwaters, palace and a single inland hall, linked by pale roads. Far beyond, one ship's lantern is only a pinprick on the black sea.
night_overlook.absent: No foreground observer, identifiable figures, visible ship hull, European lantern in the local landscape or foreign fort.

attingal_approach.label: Madampi estate near Attingal at dawn
attingal_approach.anchor: The madampi's estate near Attingal: high old laterite walls pressed round by thick groves of wet bamboo, and a closed timber gate.
attingal_approach.absent: No fire, smoke or broken gate yet. No foreign fort, European palace or extra named commander.

attingal_aftermath.label: Madampi estate near Attingal after the breach
attingal_aftermath.anchor: The same madampi's estate near Attingal after the breach: the timber gate broken open, high old laterite walls, and the inner courtyard of a tiled noble house with carved timber pillars.
attingal_aftermath.absent: No bodies or blood, no foreign fort or European palace, no extra named commander. The chief's sons are not present.
attingal_aftermath.time: early morning, smoke over the breached gate

recruit_dusk.label: Recruit at the Travancore drill ground
recruit_dusk.anchor: The edge of the Travancore drill ground, cropped tight: one unnamed young Nair recruit in a white mundu ramming a charge down his musket barrel, the ramrod mid-stroke, the flat ground soft behind him.
recruit_dusk.absent: No drill master, observers, firing line, named principal or foreign fort.

page-01-panel-01.bleed: A complete landscape memory in dry ochre, separate from the present wet-green Travancore. No present-day figure enters it.

page-02-panel-02.bleed: Three imagined livelihood inserts remain inside the same panel above Nagoji: kalari practice, pepper sorting and a paddy cart. They do not replace the temple foreground.
page-02-panel-02.lettering_space: Keep a clear band between the upper insets and the close profile for the two lettering areas.

page-02-panel-05.lettering_space: Leave the dark roof eaves above the lamp-niche wall clear for two long off-panel speech areas; the lit niches stay fully visible below them.

page-03-panel-05.lettering_space: Keep the lower pen inset clear and reserve quiet awning space above the faces for the two speeches.

page-04-panel-03.lettering_space: Keep the caption above the firing line, clear of muzzles and the drill master.

page-06-panel-02.lettering_space: Leave low-detail sky above the landscape for the two long captions.

page-06-panel-04.bleed: Three dark, desaturated threat images enter along the bottom: a palace-roof bowman, a vial above lamp oil and a half-drawn festival dagger. No victim appears. Keep Ramayyan on the present ridge path dominant.
page-06-panel-04.lettering_space: Keep the lower memory insets clear and use the upper sky beside Ramayyan for the two speeches.

page-06-panel-05.time: dusk coming in off the sea

page-07-panel-04.bleed: Temporal montage, not one continuous scene. Here the rule to draw each named person once applies to each band separately: Nagoji appears exactly once in every band, three times across the panel, the same man in three seasons, never twice within one band.
page-07-panel-04.lettering_space: Leave a continuous low-detail band above the three seasonal images for the two captions.

page-07-panel-05.lettering_space: Keep the gate conversation and waiting cart visible beneath space for three captions.

page-08-panel-02.lettering_space: Quiet space above the riders, clear of the hand and supply-map inset, for the two captions.
page-08-panel-02.bleed: Inset only, drawn inside this panel's own frame: a thin hand holding a palm leaf scratched with the estate's supply paths as plain lines. No face, no full figure, no lettering.

page-08-panel-03.time: early morning, smoke over the breached gate

page-09-panel-04.lettering_space: A quiet upper edge beside the tightly cropped forearm and knee, clear of the marks, for two captions.

character_notes.nagoji: Thick curled moustache; clean-shaven chin and jaw, smooth skin, no beard or facial scar. A tiny flush gold ear stud on the lobe with nothing hanging from it.
character_notes.ibrahim: White turban, short grey-flecked beard and a thin pale scar from the anatomical LEFT ear to the jaw; nothing on the forehead.
character_notes.yusuf: Tall and lean, white skullcap, neatly trimmed dark beard, short coat over a white tunic, no vest, no turban and no facial scar; never Ibrahim's face.
character_notes.padmini: Thick BLACK hair coiled at the nape, no grey; cotton sari hitched for walking, old Kerala drape with no stitched blouse, simple gold and long walking stick.
character_notes.ramayyan: Thin sharp features and receding hair, plain unbordered white cloth, no forehead marks or sacred thread; never the officiating priest's face.
